quiz_settings.instructions:
1. Each question has its own countdown timer. When the timer expires, the quiz automatically moves to the next question.
2. You cannot extend the question timer once it reaches zero.
3. Select one option (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
4. Your chosen answers are saved automatically.
5. The quiz will automatically submit when the total quiz duration runs out.
6. Do not refresh or close the browser tab during the test.
